newsitem.title: USA: ABC rests in Food Lion trial.
newsitem.headline: ABC rests in Food Lion trial.

text.p: Attorneys for Walt Disney Co's ABC television Friday rested the network's case in Food Lion Inc's lawsuit against ABC over the network's hidden camera investigation of its stores.
U.S. District Court Judge Carlton Tilley sent the jury, which was to hear closing arguments in the punitive damages phase of the case beginning Monday, home for the weekend.

ABC lost a suit late last year that charged it with fraud, trespass and breach of loyalty when two ABC producers used hidden cameras in a 1992 television report about the grocery store chain's sanitation and food-handling practices.
The jury awarded Food Lion $1,402 in compensatory damages. Food Lion, a unit of Belgian retailer ETS Delhaize Freres et Cie "LE LION' SA, reportedly is seeking up to $2 billion in punitive damages.
